QuestInfo.name: The Girl Who Lost Her Memory
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 47,914\nCan proceed to the 'Men in Black' quest\n
QuestInfo.0: I heard something happened to Korin of Ludibrium... I better go check up on her.
QuestInfo.1: You met a girl named Korin in a small house outside Ludibrium. Korin went missing for 10 months before and claims she doesn't remember anything from that period. She asked you to find the men in black who came to her to find out what had happened. Men in black... They seem to be from the #bOmega Sector#k...
QuestInfo.2: I met Korin, who was suffering from partial loss of memory, at Ludibrium. I was able to meet Agent Marco at the Omega Sector. He's the man wearing the black suit who held the clue regarding her lost memory.

0.0: Hello, there. I don't think we've ever met... what can I do for you here? Well, the thing is, lately I've been experiencing some very strange things, and therefore, I'm very apprehensive towards strangers. Because of that... well, um... will it be okay for you to help me out here?

yes.0: Thank you so much. Now, here's the story. I've actually been declared missing for 10 months now, but I have no recollection of what happened during the 10 months that I've been deemed missing. It's like, I woke up one day, and 10 months have passed, just like that. Isn't that strange?
yes.1: I couldn't sleep for a while because I was in shock. Luckily, there were people around me to bring me back to my senses, and I slowly started living a normal life again when two men dressed in dark suits came to me. They proceeded to ask me questions regarding the last 10 months, then left.
yes.2: I'm sure those men know what had happened to me. Please go find the #e'Men in Black'#n and find out what they know. I don't think they'll be in Ludibrium or Eos Tower...
yes.3: #b(Men in black... Maybe they're from Omega Sector? That place seems weird enough.)#k

no.0: Hmmm... You must be busy with other things. I understand. You travel around different places, and it's only natural that you're busy. If you ever find some free time, however, then please find me. I really need help from someone like you.

1.0: I would not suggest speaking to me here. Omega Sector is not for tourists. Wait, #b#p2041015##k? Hmmm...

npc.0: I don't think you have located the men in black suits yet. The only ones that know what happened to me over the past 10 months are them, and I need to find out what happened. Please find those men in black suits for me and ask them whatever they know about me, so I can recover 10 months' worth of memories.
